value.sql: SELECT `Current Unit Name`, AVG(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN datediff(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, `Received Date`) END) AS `Average Turnaround Days` FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final` GROUP BY `Current Unit Name` ORDER BY `Average Turnaround Days` ASC, `Current Unit Name` ASC
value.intent: Returns the average turnaround days per operational unit, sorted from best to worst.
